ex.s: They provide shade, lower surface temperatures, absorb a surprising amount of airborne carbon, remove tiny pollutants, and provide wildlife habitat along with just plain beauty.
ex.t: 它们提供树荫、降低地表温度、吸收空气中惊人数量的碳、去除微小污染物，还为野生动物提供栖息地，并带来纯粹的美感。

ex.t: 徒步者一定能学到很多关于布莱克斯泰尔斯地区栖息地和自然世界的知识。

ex.s: Habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change have caused dramatic declines in pollinator populations over the past couple of decades, which has damaged the US agricultural economy.
ex.t: 栖息地的丧失、杀虫剂的使用和气候变化在过去几十年中导致传粉昆虫数量急剧下降，这损害了美国农业经济。

ex.s: Over 28 states have passed laws related to pollinator habitat protection and pesticide use.
ex.t: 超过28个州已通过与传粉昆虫栖息地保护和杀虫剂使用相关的法律。

ex.s: Human impact on the animal kingdom, such as hunting and destruction of habitats, ___________a reduction in the population of certain species in the past three decades.
ex.t: 人类对动物王国的影响，如狩猎和栖息地破坏，________导致过去三十年某些物种种群数量的减少。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，已有超过五亿美元进入该基金，购买了超过500万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: Since 1934, better than half a billion dollars has gone into that Fund to purchase more than 5 million acres of habitat.
ex.t: 难怪联邦鸭票计划被称为有史以来发起的最成功的保护计划之一。

ex.s: B．Rapid economic development threatens animal habitats．
ex.t: B．它们间接攻击的物种将成为顶级捕食者。

ex.s: Thirty-three passages have been built under the railway to allow the animals to move safely and freely in their natural habitat.
ex.t: 铁路下面已经修建了33条通道，让动物们能够在自然栖息地中安全自由地移动。

ex.s: That way, it will remain a safe habitat for wildlife, as well as a dream destination for the millions of tourists who visit it each year.
ex.t: 那样的话，它将继续是野生动物的安全栖息地，也是每年数百万游客梦寐以求的目的地。

ex.s: The opportunity to see whales and dolphins swimming in their natural habitat is so much better than seeing these great mammals in zoos and aquariums.
ex.t: 有机会看到鲸鱼和海豚在它们的自然栖息地中游泳，比在动物园和水族馆里看到这些伟大的哺乳动物要好得多。

ex.s: Nor would they fail to imagine how its native inhabitants, including royal penguins, king penguins, and elephant seals, existed in perfect harmony with their natural habitat for thousands of years.
ex.t: 他们也不难想象，包括皇家企鹅、王企鹅和象海豹在内的本地居民是如何与它们的自然栖息地在完美和谐中生存了数千年。
